title: Public Key, Private Key and Address
summary: A private key is the secret that authorises spending from a wallet. A public key and the address derived from it are what you share to receive funds.
blocks: A private key is the secret that authorises spending from a wallet. A public key and the address derived from it are what you share to receive funds.
You can hand out an address freely — it only lets people send to you. The private key, and the recovery phrase that can regenerate it, must stay secret.
The whole security model rests on this split: public to receive, private to spend. Anyone with the private information controls the funds.
